title: Open Meridian app locally
done_when: App runs with pnpm dev and renders a professional initial layout.

title: View phase documents and status
done_when: Document list shows status, dependencies, and basic blockers.

title: Configure Git and local quality
done_when: Git, gitignore, Prettier, Husky, and lint-staged are configured.

title: Separate universal protocol and desktop app
done_when: meridian.md stays at root as universal protocol and Vite app stays in app-desktop.

title: Create initial skills in .agent
done_when: .agent/skills contains initial skills for agents to use with .agent/MERIDIAN.md.

title: Organize .agent operational layer
done_when: .agent contains agents, skills, workflows, rules, and scripts in Meridian standard.

title: Align .agent kit to Antigravity standard
done_when: Root README.md, always_on rules, operational agents/skills/workflows, and meridian-routing exist in the kit.

title: Monitor with three product tabs
done_when: App shows Initial Setup, Epics, and Kanban tabs with readable state per doc/US.

title: Open Meridian folder in the app
done_when: User selects the project's docs/ folder and the app persists the session handle for re-reading.

title: Markdown and frontmatter parser
done_when: Domain module extracts YAML frontmatter from .md files in docs/ without errors on existing US.

title: Initial setup with real docs
done_when: Setup tab reflects phase documents from opened folder; progress and alerts match frontmatter.

title: Deliverables tab reads docs/epics/
done_when: Deliverables tab lists EPIC-XX from opened folder with description, versions, status, and US count from same project.

title: Kanban reads user stories and board.json
done_when: Kanban tab shows US from folder with status columns, epic filter, and done_when; board.json optional as derived cache.

title: Protocol validations in the UI
done_when: App highlights doc and US inconsistencies per P0 MERIDIAN.md rules in opened folder.

title: Invoke validate_meridian.py on folder
done_when: App triggers script validation on opened folder and shows errors/warnings in UI.

title: Remove mock data.ts as source
done_when: No monitor tab imports phaseDocuments/userStories/epics from data.ts; only folder data or empty state.

title: Read phase documents in Markdown in the app
done_when: On Setup tab, each phase document (00–08 and 11) opens the corresponding .md at root of opened docs folder.

title: Onboarding to open docs folder
done_when: First use shows clear steps and a single primary CTA to open docs folder, without duplicated technical messages.

title: Consistent monitor visual shell
done_when: Layout uses single max width, spacing, and background consistent across all views.

title: Simplified top bar
done_when: Single bar combines brand, opened folder, issue count, and actions; no three message bands.

title: Tabs with manager language
done_when: Tabs use labels Setup, Deliverables, and Board; technical descriptions only on active tab or in tooltip.

title: Kanban with lean cards
done_when: Cards show title and delivery; technical details collapsed; epic filter shows readable name.

title: Kanban shows EPIC-XX and epic title
done_when: Cards and filters show EPIC-XX alongside abbreviated epic title.

title: Kanban with version badge and filter
done_when: Each card shows version badge; board filters by v0/v1/v2.

title: Deliverables with version → epic hierarchy
done_when: Deliverables tab groups by version, lists epics with US count and version sprints.

title: Board sorts US by ID
done_when: Kanban columns list US in ascending numeric order (US-0001, US-0002…).

title: Validate and expose versions and sprints in UI
done_when: Loader reads docs/versions/ and docs/sprints/; alerts cite file; Deliverables shows sprints per version.

title: Board with consistent visual tokens
done_when: Kanban and issue banner use bg-card/border-border; filters in single panel; no loose zinc-*.

title: Deliverables with cards and progress bar
done_when: Each version in card with highlighted header, progress % and visual bar; epics with mini progress.

title: Monitor shell with logo and refined background
done_when: Top bar uses favicon; page with subtle gradient; welcome screen aligned to tokens.

title: Setup with consistent visual tokens
done_when: Locked/draft states and phase icon use bg-muted and stroke-border; no zinc-* on Setup tab.

title: Advanced tools with consistent panel
done_when: AdvancedToolsPanel and ScriptValidationPanel use monitorDashedPanelClass and inlineCodeClass.

title: EPIC-06 complete — visually unified monitor
done_when: No zinc-* in src/features/monitor/; EPIC-06 marked complete.

title: Global version filter in monitor
done_when: Deliverables and Board share same version filter; default to active version or last with US.

title: Epic filter cascaded by version
done_when: Epic chips on Board list only epics with US in selected version; epic resets when version changes.

title: Focused Deliverables with flat layout
done_when: Deliverables highlights global filter version; other versions collapsed; epics in flat rows.

title: Compact board with details in sheet
done_when: Kanban cards are compact rows; done_when and deps open in sheet; empty columns hidden when filtering version.

title: Advanced tools only on Setup
done_when: AdvancedToolsPanel appears only on Setup tab; Deliverables and Board without dashed panel above.

title: JSON decision log per day
done_when: docs/decisions/YYYY-MM-DD.json is log source; validate_meridian.py validates schema; .agent kit documents prepend in entries.

title: Decisions tab in monitor
done_when: Decisions tab lists days and entries from docs/decisions/ folder with structured detail in side sheet.

title: Scaffold app-visual-studio extension
done_when: app-visual-studio/ loads in Extension Development Host with pnpm dev/build scripts documented.

title: Detect Meridian workspace in extension
done_when: Extension detects .agent/MERIDIAN.md and docs/ folder and exposes status in the status bar.

title: Document v2 extension layer in phase docs
done_when: 05_architecture, 01_tech_stack, 02_security, and 08_environments describe app-visual-studio/ layer and commands.

title: generate_board.py script in kit
done_when: .agent/scripts/generate_board.py reads docs/us/ and writes docs/kanban/board.json matching board-schema.

title: Meridian Sync Board command
done_when: Command Meridian Sync Board runs generate_board.py and shows success or errors in the editor.

title: Meridian Validate Project command
done_when: Command Meridian Validate Project runs validate_meridian.py and lists errors and warnings in the editor.

title: Meridian New User Story command
done_when: Command creates a new US-XXXX.md in docs/us/ from kit template with epic and version picker.

title: Validate US frontmatter before write
done_when: New US command rejects invalid epic, version, depends_on, or empty done_when before writing file.

title: Auto-regenerate board after US create or save
done_when: After creating or saving a US under docs/us/, board.json regenerates without a separate manual fragile step.

title: Epic and version file templates
done_when: Commands create or open epic and version files from kit templates under docs/epics/ and docs/versions/.

title: Monitor stale board.json warning
done_when: Monitor shows warning when board.json frontmatter differs from parsed docs/us/ files.

title: Extension kit docs and CI
done_when: Kit documents extension workflow and GitHub Actions runs extension compile/lint on PR.

title: v2 go-live and EPIC-05 complete
done_when: versions/v2.md go-live checklist checked; EPIC-05 status complete; v2 status complete.

title: Tauri architecture decision
done_when: 05_architecture documents Tauri choice, folder layout, and script invocation with decision log entry.

title: Scaffold Tauri desktop shell
done_when: Tauri dev loads existing Vite monitor UI inside native window on macOS.

title: Native desktop CI and build matrix
done_when: CI produces Tauri build artifact on tag; platform scope documented.

title: Native validate and sync board
done_when: Production Tauri build runs validate_meridian.py and generate_board.py without Vite dev API.

title: Persist last opened docs folder
done_when: Native app restores last docs/ path on relaunch when still accessible.

title: File watcher refreshes monitor
done_when: Changing us/*.md or board.json on disk refreshes loaded project data without manual re-open.

title: v3 go-live and EPIC-07 complete
done_when: versions/v3.md checklist done; EPIC-07 complete; v3 status complete.

title: Meridian New Sprint wizard
done_when: Extension creates docs/sprints/vX-SY.md from kit sprint template with valid stories list.

title: Meridian Complete User Story wizard
done_when: Extension guides complete-user-story flow: acceptance, tests executed, technical implementation, status done.

title: Meridian New Decision wizard
done_when: Extension prepends structured entry to docs/decisions/YYYY-MM-DD.json per kit schema.

title: US status commands with board sync
done_when: Palette commands set US status with validator-safe frontmatter updates.

title: Validator Problems panel integration
done_when: validate_meridian.py errors appear as VS Code diagnostics with file links.

title: Monitor hints for extension actions
done_when: US detail sheet in monitor shows suggested extension commands for status changes and sync.

title: v4 go-live and EPIC-08 complete
done_when: versions/v4.md checklist done; EPIC-08 complete; v4 status complete.

title: Export board to CSV
done_when: Command exports board columns to CSV file chosen by user.

title: Export sprint summary markdown
done_when: Command generates markdown report for selected sprint with US table and progress counts.

title: Link GitHub repo in monitor
done_when: Monitor settings store optional GitHub repo URL and show link on Deliverables header.

title: Last commit on docs/us
done_when: When git available locally, monitor shows last commit touching docs/us/ (read-only).

title: v5 go-live and EPIC-09 complete
done_when: versions/v5.md checklist done; EPIC-09 complete; v5 status complete.

title: Validate technical implementation section in monitor
done_when: Monitor flags US with status ✅ or 🔶 when ## Technical implementation is missing or still placeholder, using pure functions in story-body.ts.

title: Documentation badge on kanban cards
done_when: Each kanban card shows a compact Doc / Sem doc indicator derived from technical implementation status; ✅ without doc matches card warning styling.

title: Lean kanban columns — hide empty and collapse frozen
done_when: Board shows only columns with at least one visible US by default; frozen column hidden when empty and expandable via control when frozen US exist.

title: Lightweight project index on folder open
done_when: Opening docs/ builds a frontmatter-only project index; monitor tabs use the index; full markdown bodies load from disk only when a reader or sheet opens.

title: Header and navigation redesign
done_when: The app header shows project identity and the current folder path; the active tab uses a visual treatment that reads as navigation state, not a primary action button; a page subtitle gives immediate context without occupying a dedicated row.

title: Setup screen redesign
done_when: Setup document cards communicate their status visually without requiring the user to read a legend; the progress summary is the visual anchor of the page; the 'next focus' recommendation is prominently placed.

title: Deliverables screen redesign
done_when: Deliverables shows version progress as the dominant visual element; sprint chips communicate status through color; epic rows show inline progress bars; planned versions are visually distinct from active/complete ones.

title: Board screen redesign
done_when: Board empty states are designed and informative; filter controls are visually unified; kanban cards have clear internal hierarchy; status column headers use system icons consistent with the rest of the UI.

title: Story Detail redesign
done_when: Story Detail panel shows no raw YAML frontmatter; metadata and content are visually separated; the layout is readable on first open without scrolling past a code block.

title: Board grouped-by-epic accordion layout
done_when: The Board has a layout toggle that switches between the current column view and an epic-grouped accordion view, where each epic expands to show its stories organised by status column.

title: Open user story sheet from sprint deliverable
done_when: From a sprint deliverable sheet, each linked US opens Story Detail in a nested sheet without closing the sprint sheet; closing the story sheet returns to the sprint sheet.

title: Deterministic open-folder reset and visible errors
done_when: Every Open folder runs a single deterministic session reset with generation-guarded async work; no code path leaves status open without a successful bind; all failures surface in UI or issues banner (zero silent catch).

title: Clickable depends_on list in Story Detail
done_when: Story Detail shows each depends_on US as its own row (id + title when loaded); tapping a loaded dependency opens Story Detail in a nested sheet without closing the parent story sheet; missing ids are visible but not openable.

title: By-epic board spacing and status summary on epic rows
done_when: In Board By epic layout, the epic accordion list has top spacing aligned with the column view, and each collapsed epic row shows per-column US counts (Pending, In progress, Awaiting tests, Complete, Frozen only when > 0) derived from the same kanban rules as the inner grid.

title: Local HTTP file server sidecar replacing File System Access API
done_when: Running `pnpm dev` starts a local HTTP file server; the user enters a folder path once in the browser UI; F5 reloads all documents and board state without any folder picker appearing; the path is restored from localStorage on every subsequent load.

title: Scrum ↔ Meridian map in kit and monitor guide
done_when: Kit has scrum-meridian-map.md and human-only scrum-guide-complete.md; agents are directed to the map not the textbook; app How it works shows Scrum and Meridian with synthesis diagram; v2.01 lists this US; validate_meridian.py passes.

title: Board kanban webview in VS Code extension sidebar
done_when: Installable extension shows Meridian activity bar with Board webview — kanban columns from docs/us/, card click opens US file.

title: Board filter toolbar in VS Code extension editor tab
done_when: Meridian Board editor tab shows version, epic, and frozen filters with persisted state and filtered kanban columns.

title: Deliverables webview in VS Code extension editor tab
done_when: Extension opens Deliverables editor tab listing versions, sprints, and epics with progress; click opens docs file in editor.

title: Board and Deliverables filter UX parity in extension
done_when: Board and Deliverables use the same version filter (All, None, multi-select chips); Deliverables accordions expand/collapse correctly.

title: v4 go-live — extension package, architecture sync, release closure
done_when: v4 marked complete; 05_architecture and v4 go-live checklist done; .vsix builds; EPIC-05 closed for v4 scope.

title: Versions, Sprints, and Epics editor tabs in VS Code extension
done_when: Extension exposes Open Versions (no filter), Open Sprints and Open Epics (with filters); Deliverables command aliases Versions.

title: Meridian Sync Board command writes board.json from docs/us
done_when: Meridian: Sync Board regenerates docs/kanban/board.json from US frontmatter and reports count in Output.

title: Pagination and page size in planning list webviews
done_when: Versions, Sprints, and Epics list webviews paginate with Show 25/50/100 (default 50) and persist page preference.

title: Board kanban per-column pagination and All default filters
done_when: Board opens with all versions and epics selected; each kanban column paginates independently with shared page size.

title: Command help reference tab in VS Code extension
done_when: Meridian: Open Command Help shows a reference tab explaining every extension command including Validate, Sync Board, and Workspace status.

title: Distributable meridian-kit install and surgical IDE sync
done_when: Manager builds meridian-kit tarball, installs into an external project, upgrades with --force, and IDE adapters sync without deleting non-Meridian files in .cursor/ or .claude/.

title: Multi-product docs resolution (manifest A + discovery B)
done_when: Extension lists every Meridian docs/ in the repo, respects .meridian/projects.json, persists active project, validates packageRoot; kit documents the same contract.

title: Project context strip in Board and Deliverables
done_when: Board and Deliverables show active project name and docs/ path; reopening panels keeps the saved project; switching from the toolbar or command refreshes all open Meridian tabs without re-prompting on every open.

title: Codex IDE adapter sync
done_when: Install or sync creates .agents/skills/workflow-*, .codex/agents/*.toml, and AGENTS.md symlink without breaking kit skills; documented in IDE_ADAPTERS.md.

title: Extension onboarding and guide panels
done_when: Manager opens four guides in order from the extension, understands extension vs chat and workflow vs agent, and installs meridian-vscode-1.1.13.vsix.

title: SQLite schema for delivery artifacts
done_when: Schema migration creates all delivery tables; ER diagram in 06_database; meridian_db.py can open DB and list tables.

title: Database bootstrap and .meridian layout
done_when: Running bootstrap on app-desktop creates .meridian/meridian.db with latest schema and idempotent re-run.

title: Migration script — import delivery artifacts from Markdown
done_when: migrate_md_to_sqlite.py imports all dogfood epics, versions, sprints, and US with matching row counts.

title: Migration script — import decisions and board history
done_when: All docs/decisions/*.json entries imported; board snapshot stored or regenerated with matching card count.

title: Validator reads delivery artifacts from SQLite
done_when: validate_meridian.py app-desktop passes on DB-backed project with same structural rules as Markdown mode.

title: Board generator derives board.json from SQLite
done_when: generate_board.py writes board.json from SQLite with same card ids as pre-migration snapshot.

title: Kit write path persists artifacts to database
done_when: /create-us flow inserts US row in SQLite without new docs/us/*.md; refine and complete update same row.

title: app-desktop monitor loads delivery data from SQLite
done_when: Board and Deliverables tabs show epics, versions, sprints, and US from .meridian/meridian.db on dogfood.

title: Document phase-doc vs database boundary
done_when: 06_database.md and 05_architecture.md approved with explicit Markdown vs SQLite split.

title: Repo lineage — meridian-v1-old and main cutover
done_when: Branch meridian-v1-old exists; MERIDIAN_V2_CUTOVER.md runbook reviewed; README notes v1 vs v2.

title: Summary columns schema migration
done_when: Migration 20260718110000 adds summary TEXT to delivery tables; bootstrap applies idempotently.

title: meridian_db_cli query commands for agents
done_when: meridian_db_cli supports list, show, search, counts for delivery entities without raw SQL.

title: verify_md_sqlite_parity.py migration verification
done_when: Parity script compares delivery .md files to SQLite rows and exits non-zero on any mismatch.

title: Summary backfill and complete-us summary generation
done_when: Backfill script populates summary for migrated rows; complete-us skill writes summary on close.

title: Kit skills SQLite-only write path
done_when: create/refine/complete/sync skills persist only to SQLite; no Write on docs/us or sibling delivery folders.

title: Validator --sqlite-only rejects delivery markdown files
done_when: validate_meridian.py --sqlite-only errors when docs/us, epics, versions, sprints, or decisions/*.json exist.

title: VS Code extension reads delivery from SQLite
done_when: Extension board and deliverables load from meridian_db export when meridian.db exists.

title: Protocol documentation for SQLite-only workflow
done_when: 06_database, 05_architecture, MERIDIAN.md, skills, and agents-help document SQLite-only + CLI + summary pipeline.

title: purge_delivery_md.py safe removal of delivery markdown
done_when: purge script deletes delivery .md/json only after verify passes; supports --dry-run.

title: Dogfood cutover verify purge validate end-to-end
done_when: Dogfood repo runs verify, purge, validate --sqlite-only, extension test, and generate_board on SQLite only.
